value\n\nimport (\n\t\"bytes\"\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// TestDefaultContextAuthenticatedData verifies that DefaultContext implements\n// Context and returns itself from AuthenticatedData.\nfunc TestDefaultContextAuthenticatedData(t *testing.T) {\n\tdata := []byte(\"authenticated-data\")\n\tdc := DefaultContext(data)\n\tgot := dc.AuthenticatedData()\n\tif !bytes.Equal(got, data) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"AuthenticatedData() = %q, want %q\", got, data)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestDefaultContextNil verifies that a nil DefaultContext returns nil from\n// AuthenticatedData, not a panic.\nfunc TestDefaultContextNil(t *testing.T) {\n\tvar dc DefaultContext\n\tgot := dc.AuthenticatedData()\n\tif got != nil {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"AuthenticatedData() on nil DefaultContext = %q, want nil\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestDefaultContextEmpty verifies that an empty DefaultContext returns an\n// empty (non-nil) byte slice from AuthenticatedData.\nfunc TestDefaultContextEmpty(t *testing.T) {\n\tdc := DefaultContext([]byte{})\n\tgot := dc.AuthenticatedData()\n\tif got == nil {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"AuthenticatedData() on empty DefaultContext = nil, want empty slice\")\n\t}\n\tif len(got) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"AuthenticatedData() on empty DefaultContext len = %d, want 0\", len(got))\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestTransformerRoundTrip verifies that a PrefixTransformer correctly encodes\n// data to storage and decodes it back, preserving the original value.\nfunc TestTransformerRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {\n\toriginal := []byte(\"hello-world\")\n\ttransformed := []byte(\"transformed-hello-world\")\n\tinner := &testTransformer{\n\t\tfrom: original,\n\t\tto:   transformed,\n\t}\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: inner},\n\t)\n\n\tctx := context.Background()\n\n\t// Write path: TransformToStorage should prepend the prefix.\n\tencoded, err := pt.TransformToStorage(ctx, original, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformToStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\twant := append([]byte(\"enc:\"), transformed...)\n\tif !bytes.Equal(encoded, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformToStorage() = %q, want %q\", encoded, want)\n\t}\n\n\t// Read path: TransformFromStorage should strip the prefix and delegate.\n\tdecoded, stale, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(ctx, encoded, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif stale {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() stale = true, want false for first transformer\")\n\t}\n\tif !bytes.Equal(decoded, original) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() = %q, want %q\", decoded, original)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerMismatch verifies that data with an unrecognized prefix\n// returns the configured default error.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerMismatch(t *testing.T) {\n\tdefaultErr := fmt.Errorf(\"no matching transformer\")\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(defaultErr,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\")}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"other:value\"), nil)\n\tif err != defaultErr {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() with unknown prefix: err = %v, want %v\", err, defaultErr)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerStaleOnNonFirst verifies that data decoded by a\n// non-first transformer is always marked stale to trigger a rewrite with\n// the current (first) transformer.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerStaleOnNonFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"new:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\")}},\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"old:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\")}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, stale, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"old:data\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !stale {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() stale = false, want true for non-first transformer match\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerNotStaleOnFirst verifies that data decoded by the first\n// transformer is not marked stale when the underlying transformer also is not stale.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerNotStaleOnFirst(t *testing.T) {\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"new:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\"), stale: false}},\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"old:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\")}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, stale, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"new:data\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif stale {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() stale = true, want false for first transformer match\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerInnerStalePreserved verifies that if the inner\n// transformer reports stale=true on the first-position transformer, the stale\n// flag is propagated to the caller.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerInnerStalePreserved(t *testing.T) {\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\"), stale: true}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, stale, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"enc:data\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !stale {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() stale = false, want true when inner transformer reports stale\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerErrorPropagation verifies that errors from the\n// underlying transformer during reads are surfaced to the caller.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerErrorPropagation(t *testing.T) {\n\tinnerErr := fmt.Errorf(\"decryption failed\")\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{err: innerErr}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"enc:data\"), nil)\n\tif err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"TransformFromStorage() expected error, got nil\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerToStorageError verifies that errors from the underlying\n// transformer during writes are propagated to the caller.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerToStorageError(t *testing.T) {\n\tinnerErr := fmt.Errorf(\"encryption failed\")\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{err: innerErr}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, err := pt.TransformToStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"data\"), nil)\n\tif err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"TransformToStorage() expected error, got nil\")\n\t}\n\tif err != innerErr {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformToStorage() err = %v, want %v\", err, innerErr)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerToStorageUsesFirstTransformer verifies that\n// TransformToStorage always delegates to the first listed PrefixTransformer,\n// regardless of how many transformers are configured.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerToStorageUsesFirstTransformer(t *testing.T) {\n\tfirst := &testTransformer{to: []byte(\"from-first\")}\n\tsecond := &testTransformer{to: []byte(\"from-second\")}\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"first:\"), Transformer: first},\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"second:\"), Transformer: second},\n\t)\n\n\tresult, err := pt.TransformToStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"input\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformToStorage() unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\twant := []byte(\"first:from-first\")\n\tif !bytes.Equal(result, want) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformToStorage() = %q, want %q\", result, want)\n\t}\n\tif second.receivedTo != nil {\n\t\tt.Error(\"second transformer was invoked during TransformToStorage, should not have been\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerPrefixStrippedBeforeInnerTransform verifies that the\n// configured prefix is stripped from data before it is passed to the inner\n// transformer's TransformFromStorage method.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerPrefixStrippedBeforeInnerTransform(t *testing.T) {\n\tinner := &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"decoded\")}\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: inner},\n\t)\n\n\t_, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"enc:raw-data\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"unexpected error: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !bytes.Equal(inner.receivedFrom, []byte(\"raw-data\")) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"inner transformer received %q, want %q (prefix must be stripped)\", inner.receivedFrom, \"raw-data\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerEmptyValue verifies that empty input bytes can be\n// transformed and decoded without error.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerEmptyValue(t *testing.T) {\n\tinner := &testTransformer{from: []byte{}, to: []byte{}}\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: inner},\n\t)\n\n\tctx := context.Background()\n\tencoded, err := pt.TransformToStorage(ctx, []byte{}, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformToStorage() with empty value: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Output should be just the prefix since transformed value is empty.\n\twantEncoded := []byte(\"enc:\")\n\tif !bytes.Equal(encoded, wantEncoded) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformToStorage() = %q, want %q\", encoded, wantEncoded)\n\t}\n\n\tdecoded, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(ctx, encoded, nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() with prefix-only value: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !bytes.Equal(decoded, []byte{}) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() = %q, want empty slice\", decoded)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestNewPrefixTransformersDefaultError verifies that passing nil as the error\n// to NewPrefixTransformers results in a meaningful default error when no prefix\n// matches, rather than a nil error (which would be ambiguous).\nfunc TestNewPrefixTransformersDefaultError(t *testing.T) {\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"val\")}},\n\t)\n\n\t_, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"other:data\"), nil)\n\tif err == nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected non-nil error for unmatched prefix when nil error passed to NewPrefixTransformers\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerIdentityPrefixFallthrough verifies the identity-prefix\n// fallthrough: a transformer with an empty prefix matches everything, but if it\n// returns an error, the next transformer in the list is tried instead.\nfunc TestPrefixTransformerIdentityPrefixFallthrough(t *testing.T) {\n\tinnerErr := fmt.Errorf(\"identity transformer error: data appears encrypted\")\n\t// Identity transformer errors (e.g., detects encrypted data), then the real\n\t// transformer decrypts it successfully.\n\tpt := NewPrefixTransformers(nil,\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte{}, Transformer: &testTransformer{err: innerErr}},\n\t\tPrefixTransformer{Prefix: []byte(\"enc:\"), Transformer: &testTransformer{from: []byte(\"decrypted\")}},\n\t)\n\n\tgot, _, err := pt.TransformFromStorage(context.Background(), []byte(\"enc:ciphertext\"), nil)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"TransformFromStorage() unexpected error after identity fallthrough: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tif !bytes.Equal(got, []byte(\"decrypted\")) {\n\t\tt.Errorf(\"TransformFromStorage() = %q, want %q\", got, \"decrypted\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPrefixTransformerMultipleTransformers exercises TransformFromStorage with\n// multiple
